title: Long-time existence of the pluriclosed flow on some fibrations
summary: We prove long-time existence of the pluriclosed flow on certain compact quotients of Lie groups for non-invariant initial data, as well as on some holomorphic principal torus bundles over nonpositively curved Kähler manifolds. In particular, our results cover the cases of nilmanifolds and almost-abelian solvmanifolds, and provide a new proof of the long-time existence of the pluriclosed flow on certain complex surfaces, originally established by Garcia-Fernandez, Jordan, and Streets.
